pattern: union two differently-headered tables after renaming, pivot with conditional aggregation
question: centre wise attendance percentage for 2023 and 2024 side by side - average of the monthly rates
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre
sql_duckdb: WITH monthly_2023 AS (SELECT "Centre", AVG(CAST("Avg Daily Present" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0), 0) * 100) AS avg_pct_2023 FROM "attendance_2023" GROUP BY "Centre"), monthly_2024 AS (SELECT "centre_name" AS "Centre", AVG(CAST("average_attendance" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF("enrolment", 0), 0) * 100) AS avg_pct_2024 FROM "attendance_2024" GROUP BY "centre_name") SELECT m2023."Centre", m2023.avg_pct_2023, m2024.avg_pct_2024 FROM monthly_2023 AS m2023 JOIN monthly_2024 AS m2024 ON m2023."Centre" = m2024."Centre" ORDER BY m2023."Centre" NULLS FIRST

WITH monthly_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    "Centre",
    AVG(CAST("Avg Daily Present" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) * 100) AS avg_pct_2023
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  GROUP BY "Centre"
),
monthly_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    "centre_name" AS "Centre",
    AVG(CAST("average_attendance" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) * 100) AS avg_pct_2024
  FROM "attendance_2024"
  GROUP BY "centre_name"
)
SELECT 
  m2023."Centre",
  m2023.avg_pct_2023,
  m2024.avg_pct_2024
FROM monthly_2023 m2023

ORDER BY m2023."Centre";
